title: 第7章 两本书两把刀第8章 钓鱼收获箱子
content_zh:
母亲给王奶奶一家和周爷爷，吴爷爷每家一条红烧鱼！
晓丽喊道，“晓天，拿碗筷，准备开饭啦！”
好嘞，晓丽开始盛鱼，一条七八斤的大鱼被装在盆里，稳稳当当地放在桌子上……
父亲看到鱼，一点也不惊讶，母亲已经把鱼和二儿子拿回来的东西都告诉他了！父亲虽然有点半信半疑！
“明天带你们一起去，钓鱼卖鱼，让你们见识见识我钓鱼的厉害！”
弟弟妹妹们没有一个不相信的，反而对二哥的话深信不疑！
父母虽然有点疑惑，但也没有证据，这顿饭大家吃得可开心了！
大家吃得饱饱的，都夸这鱼好吃！吃完饭，张昊宇就和两个小不点妹妹玩了起来。
这个年代都是吃完饭就休息，因为运动消化得快！
张昊宇和弟弟睡一个房间，兄弟俩躺在床上。
张昊宇闭着眼睛，意念进入空间，看着地里的粮食和蔬菜，心里盘算着明天再收一次，家人就不会缺粮食了！
今天在大学拿到的种子，得翻种两次才行！
院子的左前右一共留了五十亩地，以后可以种药材，再慢慢想办法搞些各种水果树苗或者种子！
粮食就不卖了，空间里的时间流速不用种太多！
空间里产出的可都是精品！无污染，没有任何科技的加成，味道好，还有灵气滋养，对身体有很多好处。
这可不是后世那些用化肥、农药、科技改良版的绝种粮食能比的。
再慢慢找各种肉类动物，多储存些肉，反正有静止状态无限量的仓库！
有大把的时间来收集生活必需品，现在主要是先搞些急需的东西。
晚上去黑市逛逛！想着想着就睡着了，也不知道睡了多久才醒来。
一轱辘爬起来，套上衣服，挑了件衣服塞进空间，蹑手蹑脚出了门，翻墙出了院子，直奔最近的黑市。

到了黑市一看，嘿，时间刚刚好，应该是刚开始营业。
张昊宇赶紧掏出旧衣服把脑袋一蒙，走到入口处，交了一毛钱就顺利进了黑市。
他放开神识，滴溜溜地转着眼睛观察着周围，慢悠悠地溜达着！
突然，他发现一个卖鸡蛋的，二话不说，花了一块一毛钱买了20只鸡蛋，还买个装鸡蛋的树枝编的篮子！
接着观察，继续转悠，突然被一个摊位吸引住了。
只见这个摊位上铺着一块黑布，上面摆着两本书，两套细针，一套银色，一套金色。
用神识瞅了瞅，嘿，两本书，一本是药材，更让人惊喜的是，里面还有好多药方呢！
这书纸都发黄了，字还是毛笔写的繁体字。
张昊宇，虽说也是后世的大学生，还精通好几个国家的语言，可这繁体字，他还真认不全！
另一本书，是医术针法。张昊宇拿起那本有药方的书，“这是啥书啊？”
他又用神识扫了一下，摊主是个三四十岁的中青年人！
摊主听到张昊宇问，结结巴巴地，“我……我也不知道，上……上面的字我不认得，这是我们祖上传下来的！”
家里人太多，粮食不够吃，其实他也不缺钱，可是用钱也买不到粮食啊！
没办法，只好拿出这些东西来碰碰运气！都来了三天了，还没人换呢！
“你想换多少粮食？”
摊主笑眯眯地回答：“十斤细粮或者二十斤粗粮。”
张昊宇心里琢磨了一下，自己空间里有十斤大学换来的“白面。”
还有二十斤玉米面呢，“那就来十斤白面吧，这些东西我要了！”
张昊宇乐颠颠地伸出手：“拿袋子来，我去装面粉！”
摊主喜出望外，激动地从背篓里掏出一个布袋子，递给张昊宇。
content_en:
Mother gave a piece of braised fish to each family of Grandma Wang and Grandpa Zhou and Grandpa Wu!
Xiaoli shouted, "Xiaotian, get the bowls and chopsticks, get ready to eat!"
Okay, Xiaoli started to put the fish in. A big fish weighing seven or eight pounds was put in a basin and placed firmly on the table...
The father was not surprised at all when he saw the fish. The mother had already told him everything about the fish and what her second son had brought back! Although my father was a little skeptical!
"I'll take you with me tomorrow to fish and sell fish, so you can see how good I am at fishing!"
None of the younger brothers and sisters didn't believe it, but they believed in the second brother's words!
Although the parents were a little confused, there was no evidence. Everyone had a great time eating this meal!
Everyone was full and praised the fish as delicious! After eating, Zhang Haoyu started playing with his two little sisters.
In this era, it is common to rest after eating because exercise digests faster!
Zhang Haoyu and his brother slept in the same room, and the brothers lay on the bed.
Zhang Haoyu closed his eyes and entered the space with his mind, looking at the grains and vegetables in the field, thinking that if he harvested them again tomorrow, his family would not be short of food!
The seeds I got at the university today have to be replanted twice!
A total of fifty acres of land are left on the left, front and right sides of the yard. In the future, medicinal materials can be grown, and we will slowly find ways to get various fruit saplings or seeds!
The food will not be sold, and the time flow rate in space does not need to be planted too much!
The products produced in the space are all high-quality products! It is pollution-free, does not have any technological additions, tastes good, nourishes spiritual energy, and has many benefits for the body.
This is not comparable to those extinct grains improved by chemical fertilizers, pesticides, and technology in later generations.
Then slowly look for various meat animals and store more meat. Anyway, there is an unlimited warehouse in a static state!
There is plenty of time to collect daily necessities, but now the main thing is to get some urgently needed things first.
Go shopping in the black market at night! I fell asleep while thinking about it, and I don’t know how long I slept before I woke up.
He climbed up, put on his clothes, picked out some clothes and stuffed them into the space, tiptoed out of the door, climbed over the wall and out of the yard, and headed straight to the nearest black market.
When I arrived at the black market, I saw, hey, the time is just right, it should have just opened.
Zhang Haoyu quickly took out his old clothes, covered his head, walked to the entrance, paid a dime and successfully entered the black market.
He let go of his consciousness, rolled his eyes and observed the surroundings, strolling slowly!
Suddenly, he found an egg seller. Without saying a word, he bought 20 eggs for one yuan and ten cents, and also bought a basket made of branches to hold the eggs!
Then I observed and continued to wander around, and suddenly I was attracted by a stall.
I saw a piece of black cloth spread on this stall, with two books on it, and two sets of fine needles, one silver and one gold.
I took a look at it with my spiritual sense, hey, there are two books, one is medicinal materials, and what’s even more surprising is that there are many prescriptions in it!
The paper is yellowed, but the words are still traditional Chinese characters written with a brush.
Although Zhang Haoyu is also a later generation college student and is proficient in the languages ​​​​of several countries, he really can't recognize all the traditional Chinese characters!
Another book is about medical acupuncture. Zhang Haoyu picked up the book with the prescription, "What kind of book is this?"
He scanned it again with his spiritual consciousness and found that the stall owner was a young and middle-aged man in his thirties or forties!
When the stall owner heard Zhang Haoyu ask, he stammered, "I...I don't know either. I don't recognize...the words on it. They are handed down from our ancestors!"
There are too many people in the family and there is not enough food to eat. In fact, he is not short of money, but he can't buy food with money!
I have no choice but to take out these things and try my luck! It’s been three days and no one has changed it yet!
"How much grain do you want to exchange?"
The stall owner replied with a smile: "Ten pounds of fine grains or twenty pounds of coarse grains."
Zhang Haoyu thought about it in his mind, and found that there were ten pounds of "white noodles" obtained from college in his space.
There are still twenty kilograms of cornmeal, "Then let's get ten kilograms of white cornmeal."Come on, I want these things! "
Zhang Haoyu stretched out his hand happily: "Bring the bag, I'll put the flour in it! "
The stall owner was overjoyed and excitedly took out a cloth bag from his backpack and handed it to Zhang Haoyu.
